title: Vera previews her proposed changes on the page in the website editor, read-only, before the owner applies them

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (Vera makes the changes the user directs, confirm before write) and 20:39Z (I approve everything, get this done); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V2 ghost diff in the editor (pattern 3, ghost then accept). Builds on LIVE-2097, LIVE-2098 and LIVE-2135.

detail:
Vera's proposal was a list of lines; the owner had to apply them to see the result and undo if it was wrong. Add Preview on page: while it is on, the canvas draws the page with the ticked section lines applied, read-only, under a banner that says nothing is on the draft yet (style lines are counted and show once applied). Ticking a line updates the preview. The preview lives on the proposal, so Dismiss, Apply or a new ask turns it off; Apply stays the only way onto the draft, as one undo step.

Shipped: websiteVeraGhost in vera-layout.ts, the Preview on page toggle and banner in both editor layouts, tests and probe.
